tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ BT-85 acceptance: add a real make cover-check gate using go test ./... -count=1 -short -coverprofile=<tmp>; enforce total >=80% and every non-exempt package >=60%, with named reasoned exemption for statement-less internal/secretscheck. Make the gate load-bearing: pass at current coverage and forced failure (for example min-package 95) naming the offending package. Add hermetic checker unit tests for total/package below floor, exemption, empty/malformed profile, exact boundary. CI runs the same command as make cover-check, README documents target/floors/exemptions. Preserve all existing build/vet/full-test/fmt/version/spec/vuln gates and leave no generated artifacts.: Makefile:108-113 defines cover-check: `COVER_MIN_TOTAL ?= 80`, `COVER_MIN_PACKAGE ?= 60`, `@tmp=$$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf $$tmp' EXIT; go test ./... -count=1 -short -coverprofile=$$tmp/coverage.out >/dev/null && go run ./cmd/covercheck --profile=$$tmp/coverage.out --min-total=$(COVER_MIN_TOTAL) --min-package=$(COVER_MIN_PACKAGE) --exempt=internal/secretscheck`. Exemption is named+reasoned (Makefile:91-107 comment; internal/covercheck/covercheck.go package doc: internal/secretscheck is a zero-statement test-only package; cmd/covercheck/main.go defaultExempt). LOAD-BEARING PROVEN: `make cover-check` -> EXIT=0, output 'covercheck: total 83.1% of statements (floor 80.0%)', 'lowest package .../internal/describe 66.5% (floor 60.0%)', 'exempt internal/secretscheck: not present in profile (zero statements, exempt by policy)', 'PASS: 14 packages evaluated'. `make cover-check COVER_MIN_PACKAGE=95` -> EXIT=2 (make error on checker exit 1) with 13 findings naming packages, e.g. 'FAIL package github.com/coding-hermes/boardctl/internal/describe coverage 66.5% is below floor 95.0%' and 'FAIL: 13 finding(s)'. HERMETIC UNIT TESTS: `go test -count=1 ./internal/covercheck ./cmd/covercheck` -> 'ok github.com/coding-hermes/boardctl/internal/covercheck 0.004s' / 'ok .../cmd/covercheck 0.004s' (exit 0). Coverage of required cases: total below floor (covercheck_test.go:147 TestCovercheckEvaluateTotalBelowFloor), package below floor naming package (:171), exemption (:197 TestCovercheckEvaluateExemptZeroStatementPackage), empty/malformed profile (:71 TestCovercheckParseProfileErrors, 10 cases incl. empty file, whitespace-only, header-only, missing mode, malformed block, non-integer counts), exact boundary (:245 TestCovercheckEvaluateExactBoundaryPasses, 62.5/81.25 exact then one-statement-short flips both findings), forced strict floor (cmd/covercheck/main_test.go:46), env-override rejection (cmd/covercheck/no_env_override_test.go). CI PARITY: .github/workflows/ci.yml 'Coverage' step `run: make cover-check` (added in 56418f5), same command as the make target. README:1555, 1601, 1655-1683 documents the target, total 80% / per-package 60% floors, the internal/secretscheck exemption and reason, and the `make cover-check COVER_MIN_PACKAGE=95` forced-failure proof. EXISTING GATES PRESERVED: Makefile still has build:43, test:47, fmt:53, fmt-check:56, version-check:71, spec-check:79, vuln-check:88, vet:115, release/install/install-check/clean; verified `go build ./...` BUILD_OK, `go vet ./...` VET_OK, `go test -count=1 ./...` all 15 packages 'ok' (incl. internal/secretscheck, internal/vulncheck, internal/workflowcheck), `make fmt-check`/`make version-check`/`make spec-check` exit 0. NO ARTIFACTS: profile goes to a mktemp dir removed by the EXIT trap; `git status --porcelain` shows only pre-existing board/gitreins runtime files, and `find . -maxdepth 2 -name 'coverage*'` returns nothing.
The cover-check gate is real and load-bearing (passes at 83.1% total / 66.5% lowest package, fails naming 13 packages at COVER_MIN_PACKAGE=95), backed by hermetic unit tests, CI parity via `make cover-check`, README documentation of floors and the internal/secretscheck exemption, with all prior gates green and no generated artifacts left behind.
